204.description: Write data is correctly formatted and accepted for writing to the bucket.

400.description: Line protocol poorly formed and no points were written.  Response can be used to determine the first malformed line in the body line-protocol. All data in body was rejected and not written.

401.description: Token does not have sufficient permissions to write to this organization and bucket or the organization and bucket do not exist.

403.description: No token was sent and they are required.

413.description: Write has been rejected because the payload is too large. Error message returns max size supported. All data in body was rejected and not written.

429.description: Token is temporarily over quota. The Retry-After header describes when to try the write again.

Retry-After.description: A non-negative decimal integer indicating the seconds to delay after the response is received.

503.description: Server is temporarily unavailable to accept writes.  The Retry-After header describes when to try the write again.

Retry-After.description: A non-negative decimal integer indicating the seconds to delay after the response is received.
